$comment: Phosphor pre-render config for mermaid-cli (mmdc). Produces dark-theme static SVG matching phosphor.css tokens (the system is dark-first). Usage: npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli -i diagram.mmd -o diagram.svg --configFile mermaid-config.json --backgroundColor transparent. Pre-rendered SVG is single-theme by nature — pin its figure to the dark ground (#0A0F0C) so it survives the paper-terminal light theme. Keep in sync with the default token block of phosphor.css.
fontFamily: SF Mono, ui-monospace, Cascadia Code, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
